input: Any commit that modifies /moves/$k.text for any agent $k must also modify /turn/ply.num and must be signed by the key of the plan-chosen piece, so that an off-plan commit from any other agent (such as bishop_f8 or bishop_c8 being greedy) cannot be accepted without the plan-chosen piece's signature, and a commit that modifies /moves/$k.text without a matching ply number is rejected.
